input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII caps only Licensor's liability, and at one half of amounts paid — materially below the fallback of 12 months' fees and likely below six months' fees. Licensee's liability is left entirely uncapped (and is expanded by the broad one-way indemnity in Article XII), and the consequential-damages exclusion in (a) runs in Licensor's favour only. There are no carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence or wilful misconduct. This is walk-away territory (customer uncapped / vendor cap below six months' fees), so we have made the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, mutualized the consequential-damages exclusion, and added the standard uncapped Excluded Claims, with Licensee's fee obligations excluded from the cap.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, mutualize the consequential-damages exclusion, and add standard uncapped carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the liability cap mutual and set it at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, since a Licensor-only cap of one half of amounts paid (with Licensee uncapped) falls well below our position. Confidentiality, data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Licensee's fee payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.

ops.oldText: (a) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
